programs.title: Last longer
programs.subtitle: Arousal awareness, stop-start, squeeze, breathing
programs.intro: These behavioural techniques help many men gain more control. They work best with patience, and alongside medical care when needed. Practise them in private first, step by step.
programs.safety: If early ejaculation has been lifelong and bothers you a lot, see a doctor too: medical treatment is the first-line option in European guidelines, and it combines well with these techniques.

programs.title: Confidence and anxiety
programs.subtitle: CBT-style lessons, journal, calm routines
programs.intro: Performance anxiety is common and understandable. These lessons use ideas from cognitive behavioural therapy (CBT) to loosen anxious thoughts and bring attention back to sensation.
programs.safety: If anxiety or low mood are affecting your daily life, a psychologist or psychiatrist can help. In India, Tele-MANAS (14416) offers free support any time.

programs.title: Exercise for sexual health
programs.subtitle: Build to about 160 minutes a week
programs.intro: Regular aerobic exercise is one of the best-supported lifestyle steps for erections. Start with walking, build towards about 40 minutes, four times a week, and add strength work twice a week.
programs.safety: Check with a doctor before starting if you have chest pain, a heart condition, very high blood pressure, or get faint or very breathless with light activity.

programs.title: Diet for sexual health
programs.subtitle: Heart-healthy Indian and global eating
programs.intro: What's good for your heart and blood vessels is good for erections. No calorie counting here: just simple, affordable patterns that work.
programs.safety: If you have diabetes, heart or kidney disease, ask your doctor or a dietitian before changing your diet. This app never recommends supplements.

programs.title: Sleep, stress and lifestyle
programs.subtitle: Sleep, alcohol, smoking, stress, medicines
programs.intro: Small changes to sleep, alcohol and smoking add up. A weekly check-in shows your trends.
programs.safety: Never stop or change a prescribed medicine on your own. If you suspect a side effect, talk to your doctor.

programs.title: Intimacy skills
programs.subtitle: Communication, pacing, being a great partner
programs.intro: Good intimacy is built on communication, consent and attention to each other. These lessons are educational and non-explicit.
